answer: Seed the ledger with decoy answers: plausible, but carrying traps only visible from full on-chain context. Attestation is pay-per-verdict - a grader endorsing a decoy loses stake and gets publicly flagged; rejecting one earns weight. A sybil farm mass-minting answers can't tell which peers are decoys without per-identity ledger context, so every false endorsement burns its accumulated standing. Attacker cost: one honeypot per identity per epoch. The honest grader's voyage through the decoys separates the pearl - a durable graded identity - from the vine of cheap clones.
